name: Leviathan
ability: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
wakes: Never; the Storyteller announces the Leviathan at dawn of day 1 and tracks the day count.
interaction: No choices. The first good player executed gets Good player executed; a second good execution means evil wins. If day 5 ends with the Leviathan alive, evil wins.
drunk_or_poisoned: The evil-win conditions do not trigger while the Leviathan is drunk or poisoned.

jinxes.text: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
If the Leviathan nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
If the Leviathan and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, good wins.
If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
If the Leviathan is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.

rulings.text: The Leviathan never kills at night.
Any number of evil players may be executed; alignment at the time of execution is what matters.
Every execution counts, including Virgin and Mutant executions and executed players who do not die (e.g. Pacifist).
If day 5 ends and the Leviathan is alive, evil wins.

test_scenarios.name: two good executions
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Leviathan, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dan Poisoner, Eve Monk
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Bob executed. Day 2: Carol executed.

test_scenarios.name: evil executions are free
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Dan executed. Day 2: Bob executed. Day 3: no execution.
test_scenarios.expected: The game continues (only one good execution).

test_scenarios.name: day 5 limit
test_scenarios.actions: Days 1-5: at most one good player executed; Alice survives day 5.
test_scenarios.expected: At the end of day 5, evil wins.

test_scenarios.name: execution without death counts
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Leviathan, Bob Pacifist, Carol Chef, Dan Poisoner, Eve Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Carol executed. Day 2: Eve executed but the Pacifist saves her.
test_scenarios.expected: Evil wins: Eve was still executed.
